description: Halflings survive in a world of larger folk by avoiding notice or, barring that, avoiding offense. They are inclined to hospitality, home, and hearth.

features.name: Lucky
features.tldr: When you roll a 1 on the d20 for an attack roll, ability check, or saving throw, you can reroll the die and must use the new roll.

features.name: Brave
features.tldr: You have advantage on saving throws against being frightened.

features.name: Halfling Nimbleness
features.tldr: You can move through the space of any creature that is of a size larger than yours.

features.name: Halfling Subrace
features.tldr: Choose a halfling subrace such as Lightfoot or Stout.

features.name: Hearth and Home
features.tldr: You gain an innate ability to blend into crowds and find comfort in safety, granting temporary bonuses to stealth or morale.

features.name: Incredible Fortune
features.tldr: Once per rest, when a creature you can see hits you with an attack roll, you can force them to reroll.
